mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden rise in the unemployment rate above 4.5% signals weakening labor market conditions, reducing growth expectations and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises above 4.5% in a month
failure_condition: UNRATE does not cross 4.5% threshold or 20-day forward returns are positive despite the rate increase (p < 0.05 in t-test).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in both demand (GDPC1) and supply (INDPRO) indices signals inflationary pressures, driving up equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: both GDPC1 and INDPRO above 5% growth in 3-month rolling average
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative despite both proxies showing sustained growth (p > 0.05 in t-test).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.0) combined with ultra-low federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS < 2.0%) signals overheating, driving up equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL crosses above 3.0 and FEDFUNDS falls below 2.0% in the same month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) despite meeting the trigger conditions in the late-cycle regime.

mechanism_narrative: Rising labor demand (PAYEMS) coupled with falling unemployment (UNRATE) indicates a robust labor market, boosting growth expectations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases by >5% and UNRATE decreases by <0.2% in a 3-month period
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative despite the labor indicators meeting the trigger criteria (p > 0.05 in t-test).

mechanism_narrative: Sustained growth in both demand (GDPC1) and supply (INDPRO) indices over a quarter signals accelerating inflation, driving up equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: both GDPC1 and INDPRO above 5% growth in 3-month rolling average
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) despite sustained growth in both proxies.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate signals monetary tightening, raising discount rates on equity cash flows and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) despite the sustained rate increase.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden spike in the CPIAUCSL inflation index above 3.0% signals market concerns about overheating, leading to short-term negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL crosses above 3.0 in a single month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive despite the CPIAUCSL crossing above 3.0 (p < 0.05 in t-test).
